name: corporate-company-law
display_name: Corporate & Company Law — EU Directives, Governance & Shareholder Rights
description: Structured knowledge graph for EU corporate and company law covering the Codified Company Law Directive (2017/1132), Cross-Border Mobility Directive (2019/2121), Shareholder Rights Directive II (2017/828), Takeover Directive (2004/25/EC), SE Statute, and the EU corporate governance framework. Includes board duties, fiduciary obligations, capital maintenance, shareholder protection, related-party transactions, group structures, and cross-border operations.
